subject: boy
source: three stylized renders supplied by the client (front, right profile, back three-quarter), 2048x2048, grey vignette background
registration: bbox-normalized: silhouette window = square around the figure bbox padded 3% (the rule senses.occupancy_grid uses for auto-fit). Scale/translation-invariant; sensitive to extreme tips (hair, collar). The figure touches the top (hair) and bottom (collar) edges in every view; the renders share one camera framing.
segmentation: measured: background sat <= 0.039, lum 0.50-0.55 with a vignette darkening toward the lower-right corner (a luminance-low rule produced a false stripe there and was dropped). Rule: sat > 0.045 OR lum > 0.60 (linear RGB as read by Blender).

ratios_from_reference._note: W is ear-inclusive at the eye line; H_figure spans hair tip to the frame bottom (collar), not chin. 'blue eye' = iris+glow ring, the visible blue disc.

post_processing: interior holes filled at grid level (flood fill from the border); silhouettes are outline-only by definition
finding: reference eye_center_span_over_W = 0.387; canon default was 0.43; boy_v3 measured 0.389 and was penalized for matching the reference. Use reference-derived ratios, never canon.
